colorSchemes.strategy: The light tokens are the default. The browser applies the dark semantic overrides through @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark), preserving component structure and interaction meaning.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The principal local commit or cleanup action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 108px; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-on-accent, #fff); background: var(--color-accent, #3458e6); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(52 88 230 / 18%); font: 700 12px/1.4 Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong, #2948c7); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #3458e6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact recovery or row-level action with a visible boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #c7d1e2); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-accent, #3458e6); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); font: 650 11px/1.4 Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #9aade6; background: var(--color-accent-soft, #edf2ff); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #3458e6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #dfe7ff; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The compact 34px search control used in the popup and side panel; popup radius is 9px and side-panel radius is 10px.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="搜索所有标签"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 7px; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #c7d1e2); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--color-muted, #536077); background: var(--color-subtle, #f6f8fc); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-search.ds-search-sidepanel { grid-template-columns: 17px minmax(0, 1fr); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-hover, #aebbd1); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-focus, #3458e6); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus-soft, rgb(52 88 230 / 18%)); } .ds-search svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; height: 34px; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--color-ink, #152034); background: transparent; font: 400 11px/1.4 Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #536077); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: The compact binary control used for automation settings.
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display: flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--color-body, #354154); font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 22px; margin: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; appearance: none; background: #b9c3d3; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease; } .ds-switch::after { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(21 32 52 / 20%); content: ""; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-switch:checked { background: var(--color-accent, #3458e6); } .ds-switch:checked::after { transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #3458e6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Tab Row
components.description: The active tab row in the side panel's dense scan list.
components.css: .ds-tab-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 9px; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 7px 10px; align-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-ink, #152034); background: var(--color-accent-soft, #edf2ff); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-tab-row:hover { background: #dfe7ff; } .ds-tab-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #3458e6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-icon { position: relative; width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-tab-icon i { position: absolute; width: 13px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid #8f9ab0; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-tab-icon i:first-child { top: 1px; left: 1px; } .ds-tab-icon i:last-child { top: 6px; left: 5px; border-color: var(--color-accent, #3458e6); background: var(--color-accent-soft, #edf2ff); } .ds-tab-copy { min-width: 0; } .ds-tab-copy strong, .ds-tab-copy small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab-copy strong { color: var(--color-accent, #3458e6); font: 600 11px/1.3 Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-tab-copy small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--color-muted, #536077); font: 400 9px/1.3 Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Tab Caretaker is a compact operating surface built from Coco's calm adaptive workbench language. In light mode, a cool-gray canvas, white work surfaces, deep navy text, pale-blue state surfaces, and one authoritative blue carry the hierarchy. In dark mode, deep navy-charcoal surfaces, light ink, restrained blue state layers, and a brighter Coco blue preserve the same semantic hierarchy. Density stays purposeful because the interface is used to scan, search, and act on many tabs without visual ceremony.

The product keeps its own stacked-tab mark. Three offset tab rectangles move from near-white through light blue to Coco blue, preserving the caretaker identity while making the palette visibly part of the Coco family. The interface follows the operating-system preference through `prefers-color-scheme`; dark mode changes semantic token values, not component structure, density, or interaction meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, readable controls and rows preserve the extension's high information density.
Light or dark work surfaces sit on their theme canvas with one-pixel structural boundaries.
Coco blue is reserved for primary action, focus, selection, and active state.
Pale blue carries hover, selected, and informational state surfaces without becoming decoration.
The stacked-tab mark uses deep-blue and light-blue geometry without an added logo container.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Coco blue means action, focus, selection, or active state; it does not fill large decorative regions.

rules.name: The Accessible Quiet Rule
rules.body: Muted copy and placeholders use the established accessible muted color, while all focus borders and outlines use solid Coco blue.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Dark mode swaps semantic token values through `prefers-color-scheme`; it does not introduce a second component system or change the meaning of accent, surface, border, focus, success, or error roles.

rules.name: The Density Without Squinting Rule
rules.body: Reduce size for metadata, not contrast: compact labels remain readable through the muted token, deliberate weight, and short line lengths.

rules.name: The One Boundary Rule
rules.body: A resting region gets one structural boundary—tone or border—not an accumulating stack of border, shadow, and nested frame.

dos: Do preserve compact density, ellipsis behavior, and tabular numerals for counts.
Do use the active scheme's surface and canvas tokens with one-pixel borders as the primary structural system.
Do let `prefers-color-scheme` select the approved light or dark semantic values while preserving component geometry and hierarchy.
Do reserve Coco blue for action, focus, selection, active state, and the deepest layer of the brand mark.
Do keep muted and placeholder copy at the accessible muted token and focus indicators at solid Coco blue.
Do preserve visible hover, focus, loading, disabled, empty, success, and error states.
donts: Don't add a separate theme class, theme-specific component layout, decorative gradients, glass effects, or broad accent-filled regions.
Don't inflate controls, headings, or spacing at the cost of popup and side-panel scanability.
Don't stack borders, shadows, and nested rounded containers around the same resting region.
Don't replace the stacked-tab identity with Coco Travel imagery or another product mark.
Don't use low-contrast gray for secondary text or a translucent-only focus border.
